name: Spicy Tortellini with Ham, Snap Peas, Wilted Arugula & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add tortellini, and stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 765 g cheese tortellini, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve snap peas. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkgs sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice ham. Add to the bowl with the snap peas.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add snap peas, ham, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the snap peas start to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
When the snap peas are soft, add arugula to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the arugula to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add drained tortellini and Parmesan to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring often, until the cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide tortellini between plates or bowls; sprinkle with crushed red pepper. Enjoy!
